scope: Actual production Tiptap UI, keyboard input, selection/scroll, IndexedDB and isolated API/provider responses. No live Supabase/account/provider or physical-device verification.

results.name: Actual editor opens with a 220ms surface cue; real typing settles it and all characters persist
Toolbar pressed/hover feedback preserves selection and session IDs; native link/export controls stay functional
Save labels stay immediate/truthful through held writes, failure/retry and offline/reconnect
Non-AI prompts stay local; explicit request shows restrained pending/results; typing and source previews preserve authored writing
Mode/context changes discard stale guidance and reset consent; failed requests retry without altering authored content
Pause/resume/end feedback and read-only summary use existing session counters without duplicate sessions
WCAG checks at five widths plus dark theme, mobile touch-ready controls and Spanish context/summary labels
Reduced motion removes new effects; reload preserves full writing, session history and ended summary
